description: This file defines the CalendarEventQuery class, which encapsulates query parameters for retrieving calendar events, including start date, end date, calendar ID, and limit. It provides methods to convert these filters into array and string formats, enabling flexible and readable queries within a calendar module.

classes.name: CalendarEventQuery
classes.description: A class representing a query for retrieving calendar events with optional date, calendar, and limit filters. Provides methods to access query parameters, convert the query to array or string, and validate input parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CalendarEventQuery with optional start date, end date, calendar ID, and limit. Validates date order and limit value.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit for the number of results.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the query parameters into an associative array suitable for processing or API calls.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the query filters.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Magic method to convert the query object to a string, delegating to toString().
